operation.summary: Change the budget time zone or a per-spend cap (per instrument or per source). Lowering is open to any configuration agent; raising or removing a cap needs the Budgets capability. A zone change never resets a period; explicit owner.configuration grant required

body.name: namespace
body.description: live (the default) or sandbox. Only sandbox is available on this build

body.name: zone
body.description: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Warsaw

body.name: caps
body.description: {instruments: {id: money or null}, sources: {id: money or null}}; null removes a cap. Money is {unit, atoms} (a whole number of the unit's smallest part) or {unit, amount} (plain decimal text); USD-6 is millionths of a dollar

body.name: generation
body.description: The rule document generation this change replaces (from a read); a change against an older one is refused with conflict. Left out, the current one is used

operation.returns: the same as GET /rules, plus changed
